The sales guy namely Sanjay told me that since it is not available in the ship and I will take 1 day to get it from warehouse and deliver. I specifically told Sanjay , the sales person not to send me display one which he assured that he won't.
Sensing their intention I have clicked the picture of displayed light which had some marks.
And as I rightly judged this showroom , they sent me the one which was displayed.
It cost me Rs 4600/ which I now regret to chose as they have literally duped me.
